# load data and packages
```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE)) # Clear workspace

library(dplyr)
#library(skimr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(writexl) 
#library(readxl)
library(stringr) # str replace all
 
DataDir<-""
OutDir<-""
KlikDir<-""

# load meta data
meta<- read.csv(paste0(DataDir, "2026-03-17_MetaData_participants.csv"), sep = ";")

# load seclected klik participants 
klik<-read.xlsx(paste0(KlikDir, "2026-01-19_export_KLIK_Booster.xlsx"))

```


# clean data  (meta and klik)
```{r}
## dates meta ------
meta$Diag_date<-as.Date(meta$Date.diagnosis.Chronic.disease,  format = "%d-%m-%Y")
meta$T0_PreMeet_date<-as.Date(meta$Opstart,  format = "%d-%m-%Y") #T0
meta$T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date<-as.Date(meta$Evaluatiegesprek,  format = "%d-%m-%Y") #T3
# disease duration
meta$Disease_duration<-as.numeric(meta$T0_PreMeet_date- meta$Diag_date)
meta$Disease_duration<-round(meta$Disease_duration/365, 2)

## dates  -----
klik$Date_klik<-as.Date(klik$InvulDatum,  format = "%d-%m-%Y")
date<-meta[,c("Studienummer", "KLIK", "T0_PreMeet_date", "T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date")]
klik<-merge(date, klik, by.x="KLIK", by.y = "PatientID", all.y = T)

klik$T0_daysbefore<-as.numeric(klik$T0_PreMeet_date- klik$Date_klik) # if pos: klik before start study, if negative: klik after start study
klik$T3_daysafter<-as.numeric(klik$Date_klik- klik$T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date) # if pos: klik after  study, if negative: klik before end  study


# rename variables because some are too long for exporting  
## Create character vectors to specify which substrings you want to find and replace
substring_to_find <- c("baseline", "extended", "algemeen", "kind", "ouders", "proactive", "-", "self_veerkracht", "self_covid_ouder", "self_covid_k")
substring_to_replace <- c("bsl", "ext", "alg", "k", "o", "pro", "_", "k_veerkracht", "o_covid", "k_covid")
colnames(klik) <- str_replace_all(colnames(klik), setNames(substring_to_replace, substring_to_find))

```

# difference with drop-out/ exclusion
```{r}
meta$Completed<-if_else(is.na(meta$Completed), 0,meta$Completed )
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Completed = factor(Completed, levels = c(0, 1),
                       labels = c("Non-completed", "Completed"))
  )

```

```{r}

# ---- AGE ----
age_tab <- meta %>%
  group_by(Completed) %>%
  summarise(
    value = paste0(
      median(leeftijd_start, na.rm = TRUE), " [",
      quantile(leeftijd_start, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), ", ",
      quantile(leeftijd_start, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), "]"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Completed, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = "Age, median [Q1, Q3]",
    Level = ""
  )

age_p <- wilcox.test(leeftijd_start ~ Completed, data = meta)$p.value

# ---- SEX ----
sex_tab <- meta %>%
  group_by(Completed, Geslacht) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Completed) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
         value = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")) %>%
  select(-n, -pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Completed, values_from = value)

sex_p <- fisher.test(table(meta$Geslacht, meta$Completed))$p.value

# ---- EDUCATION ----
edu_tab <- meta %>%
  group_by(Completed, Education_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Completed) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
         value = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")) %>%
  select(-n, -pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Completed, values_from = value)

edu_p <- fisher.test(table(meta$Education_type, meta$Completed))$p.value

# ---- COMBINE TABLE ----
final_table <- bind_rows(
  age_tab %>%
    mutate(
      Level = as.character(Level),
      p = round(age_p, 3)
    ),

  sex_tab %>%
    rename(Level = Geslacht) %>%
    mutate(
      Level = as.character(Level),
      Variable = "Sex",
      p = round(sex_p, 3)
    ),

  edu_tab %>%
    rename(Level = Education_type) %>%
    mutate(
      Level = as.character(Level),
      Variable = "Education",
      p = round(edu_p, 3)
    )
) %>%
  select(Variable, Level, "Non-completed", Completed, p)

final_table
```

# CIS
```{r}
# CIS4 --------------------------------------
cis<-klik[klik$Vragenlijst=="kind_proactive_cis4",]
summary(cis$T3_daysafter)
cis <- cis[, colSums(is.na(cis)) / nrow(cis) <= 0.5]

# calculate the CIS sumscore 
#reverse coding items k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1, k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2, k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4
cis <- cis %>% 
  mutate(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1_recoded = recode(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1, '1'=7, '2'=6, '3'=5, '4'=4, '5'=3, '6'=2, '7'=1))
cis <- cis %>% 
  mutate(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2_recoded = recode(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2, '1'=7, '2'=6, '3'=5, '4'=4, '5'=3, '6'=2, '7'=1))
cis <- cis %>% 
  mutate(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4_recoded = recode(k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4, '1'=7, '2'=6, '3'=5, '4'=4, '5'=3, '6'=2, '7'=1))

#Calculate total score
cis <- cis %>% mutate(k_CIS4_total = rowSums(across(c("k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_1_recoded", "k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_2_recoded", "k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_3", "k_pro_cis4_CIS_4_4_recoded"))))
#Classify total score in group <20 geen vermoeidheid >= 20 wel vermoeidheid
cis <- cis %>% mutate(k_CIS4_total_bin = case_when(k_CIS4_total < 20 ~ 'geen vermoeidheid',
                                             k_CIS4_total >= 20 ~ 'wel vermoeidheid',
                                                       TRUE ~ NA))
cisT0<-cis[cis$T0_daysbefore < 90 & cis$T0_daysbefore> -14, ]
cisT0<-cisT0 %>% select(Studienummer,Date_klik,T0_daysbefore, k_CIS4_total)
names(cisT0)<-c("Studienummer","T0_Date_klik_CIS","T0_daysbefore_CIS", "T0_CIS4")
```

# FSE 
```{r}
# range: 7-28, higher is better
fse<-klik[klik$Vragenlijst=="self_qvs_selfefficacy",]
fse<-fse[ , colSums(is.na(fse))/ nrow(fse) <= 0.5]

#machteloos = reverse coded
fse <- fse %>% 
  mutate(self_qvs_selfefficacy_machteloosheid_reverse = recode(self_qvs_selfefficacy_machteloosheid, '1'=4, '2'=3, '3'=2, '4'=1))

# FSE7
#Calculate total score
fse <- fse %>% mutate(FSE7 = rowSums(across(c("self_qvs_selfefficacy_beinvloeden_moeheid", "self_qvs_selfefficacy_veranderen_moeheid", 
                                              "self_qvs_selfefficacy_instelling_moeheid", "self_qvs_selfefficacy_positief_beinvloeden",
                                              "self_qvs_selfefficacy_machteloosheid_reverse", "self_qvs_selfefficacy_controle_moeheid",
                                              "self_qvs_selfefficacy_leren_beinvloeden"  ))))
summary(fse$FSE7) # range 11 - 28

fse_items <- c(
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_beinvloeden_moeheid",
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_veranderen_moeheid",
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_instelling_moeheid",
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_positief_beinvloeden",
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_machteloosheid_reverse",
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_controle_moeheid",
  "self_qvs_selfefficacy_leren_beinvloeden"
)
cor_matrix <- cor(
  fse[, fse_items],
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
  method = "pearson"
)
round(cor_matrix, 2)

# select per timepoint
fseT0<-fse[fse$T0_daysbefore < 90 & fse$T0_daysbefore> -30, ]
fseT0<-fseT0 %>% select(Studienummer,Date_klik,T0_daysbefore, FSE7)
names(fseT0)<-c("Studienummer","T0_Date_klik_FSE","T0_daysbefore_FSE", "T0_FSE7")

```

  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(k_pro_rcads25_dep_raw = sum(c_across(all_of(variables_r25NL_dep_raw)), na.rm = TRUE))


# TOTAL ANXIETY 2,3,5,6, 7,9,11, 12,14,17,18,20,22,23,25

  mutate(T0_rcads25_dep = ifelse(all(is.na(c_across(starts_with("k_pro_rcad25_"))[1:25])), NA, k_pro_rcads25_dep_raw))
rcads <- rcads %>%
  mutate(T0_rcads25_anxiety = ifelse(all(is.na(c_across(starts_with("k_pro_rcad25_"))[1:25])), NA, k_pro_rcads25_anxiety_raw_total))

## Round off decimals to no decimals, change if you want more decimals
rcads <- rcads %>%
  mutate_at(vars(k_pro_rcads25_dep_raw:k_pro_rcads25_anxiety_raw_total), ~ round(., 0))

rcads$T0_rcads25_total<-rcads$T0_rcads25_anxiety + rcads$T0_rcads25_dep

# self-rated health ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# EQ 5D
#table(klik$Vragenlijst)
eq<- klik[klik$Vragenlijst=="self_eq5d_y",]
eq<-eq[ , colSums(is.na(eq))/nrow(eq)<=0.5]

#see; https://euroqol-domain.ams3.digitaloceanspaces.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/18154146/Netherlands-Y-3L-Roudijk-DCE-TTO-2022.txt
#### Roudijk B, Sajjad A, Essers B, Lipman S, Stalmeier P, Finch AP. A Value Set for the EQ-5D-Y-3L in the Netherlands. Pharmacoeconomics. 2022;40(Suppl 2):193-203.

eq <- eq %>%
  mutate(
    disut_mo = case_when(
      self_eq5d_y_mobiliteit == 1 ~ 0,
      self_eq5d_y_mobiliteit == 2 ~ 0.036,
      self_eq5d_y_mobiliteit == 3 ~ 0.191
    ),
    disut_sc = case_when(
      self_eq5d_y_zelfzorg == 1 ~ 0,
      self_eq5d_y_zelfzorg == 2 ~ 0.028,
      self_eq5d_y_zelfzorg == 3 ~ 0.139
    ),
    disut_ua = case_when(
      self_eq5d_y_dagelijkse_activiteiten == 1 ~ 0,
      self_eq5d_y_dagelijkse_activiteiten == 2 ~ 0.058,
      self_eq5d_y_dagelijkse_activiteiten == 3 ~ 0.211
    ),
    disut_pd = case_when(
      self_eq5d_y_pijn == 1 ~ 0,
      self_eq5d_y_pijn == 2 ~ 0.111,
      self_eq5d_y_pijn == 3 ~ 0.363
    ),
    disut_ad = case_when(
      self_eq5d_y_angst == 1 ~ 0,
      self_eq5d_y_angst == 2 ~ 0.096,
      self_eq5d_y_angst == 3 ~ 0.314
    ),
    disut_total = disut_mo + disut_sc + disut_ua + disut_pd + disut_ad,
    EQ_index = round(1 - disut_total, 3)
  )

eqT0<-eq[eq$T0_daysbefore < 90 & eq$T0_daysbefore> -30, ]
eqT0<-eqT0 %>% select(Studienummer,Date_klik,T0_daysbefore, EQ_index, self_eq5d_y_vas)
names(eqT0)<-c("Studienummer","T0_Date_klik_EQ","T0_daysbefore_EQ", "T0_EQ_index", "T0_eq5d_vas")

eqT3<-eq[eq$T3_daysafter < 60 & eq$T3_daysafter> -14, ]
eqT3<-eqT3 %>% select(Studienummer,Date_klik,T3_daysafter, EQ_index, self_eq5d_y_vas)
names(eqT3)<-c("Studienummer","T3_Date_klik_EQ","T3_daysafter_EQ", "T3_EQ_index", "T3_eq5d_vas")
```

# Baseline (avarage)
```{r}
str(met.sel)

# Helper: continuous summary
summ_cont <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]",
          median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
          quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Helper: categorical summary
summ_cat <- function(x) {
  tab <- table(x)
  pct <- prop.table(tab) * 100
  
  data.frame(
    label = paste0("  ", names(tab)),   # indent
    value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", tab, pct),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Main function
create_table1 <- function(df) {
  
  res <- list()
  
  for (var in names(df)) {
    
    x <- df[[var]]
    
    # Skip ID-like columns if needed
    if (var == "Participant") next
    
    # Continuous
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      res[[var]] <- data.frame(
        label = var,
        value = summ_cont(x)
      )
    }
    
    # Categorical (factor or character)
    else if (is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) {
      
      cat_rows <- summ_cat(x)
      
      res[[var]] <- rbind(
        data.frame(label = var, value = ""),
        cat_rows
      )
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(res)
}

# Run it
table1 <- create_table1(met.sel)

table1

```
